Add credit during suspension so the balance reaches the $3 renewal minimum.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts and data usage do not substitute for the $3 renewal charge.
A positive balance below $3 does not restore active service.
Voice/Text or Data Passes do not work on suspended or cancelled accounts.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Fund the recurring $3 PayGo service charge for each 30-day cycle. If new wallet funding is needed, Ultra’s documented Auto Renew denominations begin at $5, with $3 applied to the monthly renewal.
data.safest_documented_action: Enable Auto Renew with a valid card and enough wallet balance so the $3 recurring charge succeeds each cycle; do not rely on the suspension window.

minimum_expected_cost.note: A fresh Auto Renew top-up denomination may be $5 or more; unused wallet value remains separate from the $3 service charge.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the 30-day renewal boundary.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: Up to 60 days suspended. If balance is above $0 but below $3 after 60 days, the detailed terms provide an additional 30-day extension. If balance is $0 after 60 days, the account is cancelled without that extension.
data.termination_and_recycling: Ultra says the account and phone number are cancelled when the applicable grace path ends. The cited terms do not state the exact number-recycling timetable.
